EscalaPadrao.Nome: Default travel scale (km per ruler unit)
EscalaPadrao.Dica: How many km each grid unit (e.g. each meter) is worth in scenes without their own scale. 0 = off. Each scene can have its own in the Grid tab of the scene configuration.

KmPorDia.Dica: Only used to show days on the ruler. Default: normal pace (4.8 km/h) for 8 hours = 38.4 km. The real trip uses the pace chosen in the calendar.

MostrarNaRegua.Dica: When measuring in a scene with a travel scale, each ruler point also shows km and the last one shows days.

CorRota.Dica: Line color of routes saved on the map.

PedirRolagem.Dica: When starting a Calendário da Mesa trip (and at each dawn in day-by-day travel), a 1d100 request for the guides appears in chat.

ResultadoVisivel.Dica: Everyone: the encounter is shown in chat. GM only: players see only the rolled number.

Obstaculos.Dica: Each travel day the GM rolls 1d100 against the day's chance (route terrain + Calendário da Mesa weather). On a hit, an obstacle appears in chat with a suggested delay.

TerrenoPadrao.Dica: Terrain for trips that did not start from a route.

Escala.Dica: How many km each ruler unit is worth in this scene (world map, region...). Empty = uses the module's default scale.
Escala.DicaCurta: Saved on the scene; applies to the ruler and every route in this scene.

Rota.Visivel: Players see the route on the map
Rota.SemMedicao: Measure the path with the ruler in this scene first (drag with the ruler, click to add bends), then save.
Rota.Salva: Route saved: {nome}. Select the drawing and use the hiker button in the HUD to travel.
Rota.SemDistancia: This drawing has no distance to measure.
Rota.TerrenoDica: Sets the daily obstacle chance (road 5%, plains 10%, forest 20%, desert 25%, snow 30%, mountains and swamp 35%); the day's weather adds 10% (mild) or 25% (severe).

Viajar.CondutoresDica: Whoever leads the party rolls the 1d100 encounter each day. Nobody checked = any player may roll.
Viajar.SemJogadores: There are no players in this world.
Viajar.DiaADia: Day-by-day travel (watches and one 1d100 per dawn)
Viajar.Dica: Continue opens the Calendário da Mesa trip already filled in; there you check pace and hours per day and click Depart.
Viajar.SemEscala: Set the scale (km per unit) to compute the trip.
Viajar.SemCalendario: Table Navigation needs Calendário da Mesa active.
Viajar.CalendarioAntigo: Update Calendário da Mesa to 4.12.0 or newer: this dialog is not prefilled yet. Distance: {km} km.

Tabela.Descricao: Rolled by the guides each travel day. 1–5: disaster · 6–25: trouble · 26–75: ordinary road · 76–95: luck · 96–100: great find. Edit freely: each result's kind comes from its number range.

Emboscada.Texto: A well-armed band waits at a narrow point of the road. They strike by surprise, aiming first at the animals and the cargo.

Fera.Texto: A large, hungry creature claims this stretch of road. It stalks the party until nightfall unless someone drives it off.

Saqueadores.Texto: A small group of thieves demands a toll. They can be intimidated, persuaded or fought.

Desmoronamento.Texto: A rockfall, fallen bridge or flooded river closes the way. Going around costs half a day, or a risky check to cross.

Tempestade.Texto: A sudden storm turns the road to mud. Difficult terrain until the end of the day and a saving throw against cold or fatigue.

Viajantes.Texto: Pilgrims, couriers or a family on the move cross paths with the party. They bring news (true or not) from the destination.

Tranquilo.Texto: The road goes on without incident. A good time for conversations, memories and small scenes between the characters.

Ruinas.Texto: Ancient stones, a marker or a forgotten shrine. It may be just scenery, or the start of another story.

Rastros.Texto: Footprints, an abandoned camp or an overturned cart. A careful look reveals what passed through here.

Caravana.Texto: Friendly traders offer barter, hot food and company on the road. Prices a little better than in town.

Atalho.Texto: A hunter or an old map shows a shorter path. The party gains half a day of travel.

Fonte.Texto: Clean water, easy game and natural shelter. Tonight's rest is peaceful and everyone wakes refreshed.

Patrulha.Texto: Local guards or rangers escort the party for a stretch. Nobody dares attack, and they share valuable information.

Tesouro.Texto: A rare discovery: a forgotten cache, an unexpected ally or a special item. The GM decides the road's gift.

Pedido.NaoCondutor: Only the guides chosen by the GM roll the encounter.
Pedido.SemMestre: The GM must be online to read the encounter.

SalvarRota.Nome: Save the last measurement as a route
SalvarRota.Dica: Turns the path measured with the ruler into a route drawing on the map.

Controles.SalvarRota: Save the last ruler measurement as a route
Controles.PedirRolagem: Ask the guides for a 1d100 encounter
Controles.TestarObstaculo: Check for a road obstacle now

Buraco.Texto: Holes and broken stretches force a slow pace, leading the animals on foot.

Ponte.Texto: The bridge is closed for repairs. Wait for the ferry or look for a ford.

Pedagio.Texto: Guards search carts and ask for papers. The line moves slowly.

Carroca.Texto: An overturned cart blocks the road. Helping the owner or clearing a way takes time.

Riacho.Texto: A wide stream cuts the path. A shallow crossing must be found.

Capim.Texto: Waist-high grass hides holes. The march becomes slow and tiring.

Manada.Texto: A herd crosses the plain. Waiting is safer than going through it.

Erosao.Texto: Erosion opened a ditch across the land. The party must go around.

Arvore.Texto: A huge trunk blocks the trail. Cut through or detour into the thick woods.

Mata.Texto: The trail vanishes into the vegetation. The way must be hacked open.

Trilha.Texto: The trail markers disappear. A Survival check finds the way back.

Espinhos.Texto: A thorny stretch tears clothes and hurts the animals. Slow, painful progress.

Deslizamento.Texto: Rocks and earth have buried the pass. Clearing it or finding another route costs hours.

Desfiladeiro.Texto: The path narrows at the edge of a drop. The animals must be led one by one.

Ar.Texto: The altitude tires everyone. Constitution checks, or a level of exhaustion for anyone who pushes on.

Passagem.Texto: The main pass is blocked. The detour around the other slope takes almost a day.

Lamacal.Texto: Mud traps wheels and hooves. Every cart has to be pushed.

Areia.Texto: A patch of quicksand swallows an animal or a careless traveler.

Insetos.Texto: Mosquitoes and flies torment the party. Poor rest and a risk of fever.

Inundado.Texto: The water rose over the trail. Wade chest-deep or wait for it to drop.

Dunas.Texto: The wind moved the dunes and the landmarks are gone. The route must be redone.

Oasis.Texto: The expected oasis is dry. Ration water and detour to another well.

Miragem.Texto: The party follows a mirage for hours before noticing the mistake.

Rochas.Texto: Loose, sharp stones hurt hooves and break wheels.

Fenda.Texto: A crack hidden by snow. Whoever leads must test the ground.

LagoGelo.Texto: Crossing the ice is shorter, but it creaks. Going around is safe and slow.

Avalanche.Texto: An avalanche comes down the slope. The party must take cover, then dig out.

Branco.Texto: Snow and sky blend together. With no reference, the party walks in circles.

Lama.Texto: The rain turned the road into deep mud. Difficult terrain all day.

Cheia.Texto: The river overflowed and took the bridge or ford. Wait for the water to drop.

Raio.Texto: Lightning strikes nearby and spooks the animals, which bolt and must be rounded up.

Abrigo.Texto: The storm is too strong to go on. The party waits under a rock or tree.

Montes.Texto: Snow piles up to the knees. Every step costs double.

Congelado.Texto: Ropes, waterskins and buckles froze overnight. Setting out takes a while.

Hipotermia.Texto: The cold bites. Anyone without proper clothing makes a Constitution save.

Soterrado.Texto: The blizzard covered the whole road. A way must be shoveled open.

Perdidos.Texto: The fog swallows the road. The party only notices the wrong turn hours later.

Separados.Texto: Someone (or an animal) strays from the party in the fog. They must be called and searched for.

Marcos.Texto: Signs and markers can't be seen. Survival checks to keep the heading.

Barulho.Texto: Footsteps and voices around keep everyone on edge. It may be nothing, or not.

Tenda.Texto: The wind rips up tents and scatters the cargo. Gathering it all takes time.

Galhos.Texto: Branches and debris fly across the road. Better to wait out the gusts.

Poeira.Texto: Dust or ash blinds the party. Only slow progress with cloth over the face.

Montaria.Texto: The wind spooks the mounts. An Animal Handling check, or they refuse to go on.

Agua.Texto: The heat drains the water faster than planned. A detour is needed to find more.

Insolacao.Texto: Anyone not shielded from the sun makes a Constitution save or gains exhaustion.

Animais.Texto: The animals stop pulling in the midday heat. A forced rest in the shade.

Noite.Texto: It is so hot that the party starts walking at night and sleeping by day.

Obstaculo.DescricaoTabela: Drawn when the road gets stuck in this terrain or weather. Each result's delay in hours is in the navegacao-mesa.atraso flag; edit the texts freely.
Obstaculo.Aplicado: {h} h delay applied to the clock.
